_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: S. S. Koteliansky (1880-1955), Russian into English with his Bloomsbury collaborators: Leonard and Virginia Woolf, D. H. Lawrence, John Middleton Murry. Chekhov, Gorky's Reminiscences, Bunin, Kuprin, Shestov, Countess Tolstoy. All published 1915-1923: US public domain. UK: Koteliansky d. 1955, so PD there only since 2026; Murry (d. 1957) co-translated The Bet, The River of Life and Anton Tchekhov and Other Essays, which are UK PD only from 2028. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 17); Adam may veto. No uids minted. Round 130 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added five archive.org books: Dostoevsky's Pages from the Journal of an Author (with Murry; Luce, 1916), Chekhov's My Life and Other Stories (with Gilbert Cannan, 1920), Hippius's The Green Ring (1920), Dostoevsky: Letters and Reminiscences (with Murry, 1923) and Dostoevsky Portrayed by His Wife (1926).
_surname_note: 'koteliansky' is a unique surname, not an English word.
